Find the rounded heel at the wrist end of the lower hand. The fingers sit above the chest in this model. The close-up keeps some chest visible around the heel.
Look at the near hand: the palm folds face upward, while the nails are on the back. Compare the poses to follow its orientation as the body turns.
The palm close-up is available when the shown pose includes the near-arm step.
Compare release and peak: the heel follows the chest in both positions. Contact alone does not show full recoil; compare the chest with the resting-height line and graph.

bytePreservation.explanation: Exact owned insertion reversal was verified immediately after each write and independently reconstructed here. Current reversals and later concurrent catalog deltas are reported separately. Every original worktree snapshot remains available. When a transient OneDrive lock coincided with a concurrent catalog change, the missing insertion was rebased on a separate retained fresh worktree snapshot; both attempts and their hashes are recorded.

preExistingRegistrationGaps.scope: English Anatomy literal calls against the original dirty worktree catalog, independently of any older HEAD-based global gate.
